dataset.attribution: Nemotron-PII: Synthesized Data for Privacy-Preserving AI. Steier, Manoel, Haushalter, Van Segbroeck; NVIDIA, 2025. https://huggingface.co/datasets/nvidia/Nemotron-PII (CC BY 4.0). Only aggregate counts derived from it are published here; no records.
dataset.name: nemotron-pii
notes: The test split holds 100,000 rows: 50,000 uids, each once with locale=us and once with locale=intl (different texts). The card's '50k test' counts uids.
Span offsets are authoritative: every span's text equals the text at its offsets except for letter case (6,195) or an integer-typed value (6,747); the scorer uses offsets only.
No Singapore NRIC/FIN or IBAN label exists; those PPE types are scored for precision only.
A name is labelled as first_name and last_name separately; a system span over the full name overlaps both (found for overlap recall), but matches neither exactly (strict recall).

system.configuration: defaults (no custom recognisers, no context words added, no allow list)
system.name: presidio
